data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nadana', which means 'to give'. Nadeen is a name that evokes a sense of tenderness and kindness. In Islamic tradition, it is believed to represent the gentle and nurturing qualities of God. The name nadeen carries the meaning “Gentle, soft” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose nadeen usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, soft and live with faith, good character and purpose.
